{{Short description|None}} {{for|the discography of Glen Campbell as a group member|Glen Campbell collaborative discography}} {{Use mdy dates|date=January 2020}} {{Infobox artist discography | Artist = [[Glen Campbell]] | Image = Glen_Campbell_live_Goodtime_Theater_Branson_MI.jpg | Caption = Campbell at The Goodtime Theater, [[Branson, Missouri|Branson, MO]], 1996 | Studio = 65 | Live = 7 | Compilation = 127 | EP = | Singles = 116 | Music videos = | 1Option = 17 | 1Option name = #1 Singles (Overall) | Soundtrack = 4 }} This article presents the discography of American singer, songwriter, and guitarist [[Glen Campbell]]. Campbell recorded and released 60 studio albums and seven live albums between 1962 and 2017. He also lent his vocals to four soundtracks for motion pictures (''[[True Grit (1969 film)|True Grit]]'', ''[[Norwood (movie)|Norwood]]'', ''[[Rock-a-Doodle]]'', and ''[[Glen Campbell: I'll Be Me]]''). He placed a total of 82 singles (one of which was a re-release) on either the [[Hot Country Songs|''Billboard'' country chart]], the [[Hot 100|Billboard Hot 100]], or the [[Adult Contemporary (chart)|Adult Contemporary chart]], nine of which peaked at No. 1 on at least one of those charts. ==Studio albums== ===1960s=== {| class="wikitable plainrowheaders" style="text-align:center;" |- ! rowspan="2" style="width:24em;"| Title[{{AllMusic|class=artist|id=p1543/discography|pure_url=yes}} Glen Campbell albums] AllMusic. extract: This article presents the discography of American singer, songwriter, and guitarist Glen Campbell. Campbell recorded and released 60 studio albums and seven live albums between 1962 and 2017. He also lent his vocals to four soundtracks for motion pictures (True Grit, Norwood, Rock-a-Doodle, and Glen Campbell: I'll Be Me). He placed a total of 82 singles (one of which was a re-release) on either the Billboard country chart, the Billboard Hot 100, or the Adult Contemporary chart, nine of which peaked at No. 1 on at least one of those charts.
